description: This file defines the Data Access Object (DAO) interface 'TopicDao' for accessing 'TopicEntity' objects in a Room database. It includes methods for querying, inserting, updating, and deleting topics, specific to the 'topics' table.

classes.name: TopicDao
classes.description: Interface providing database access methods for 'TopicEntity' objects, including retrieval, insertion, update, and deletion operations

methods.name: getTopicEntity
methods.description: Fetches a single TopicEntity by its ID, returning a Flow that emits updates

methods.name: getTopicEntities
methods.description: Fetches all TopicEntity objects as a Flow emitting lists

methods.name: getOneOffTopicEntities
methods.description: Fetches all TopicEntity objects as a list, using suspend (non-reactive)

methods.name: getTopicEntities (by IDs)
methods.description: Fetches TopicEntities with IDs in the provided set, returning a Flow

methods.name: insertOrIgnoreTopics
methods.description: Inserts TopicEntity objects, ignoring conflicts if they exist; returns list of inserted row IDs

methods.name: upsertTopics
methods.description: Inserts or updates (upsert) the provided TopicEntities

methods.name: deleteTopics
methods.description: Deletes topics matching the provided list of IDs
